parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Client token, used to ensure the idempotence of requests. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client to ensure it is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier cancel-service-registration --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --registration-id sr-540930183f93xxxxxx --client-token AAAAAWns8w4MmhzeptXVRG0PUEU= --region cn-hangzhou
